newsitem.title: USA: IBM shrs rally on, further gains seen.
newsitem.headline: IBM shrs rally on, further gains seen.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp shares continued their powerful rally and technicians said that while the stock is extended in the short-term, further gains are seen.

"It looks great but it's awfully extended in the short-term," said Ken Tower, a technical analyst at UST Securities. "We're not the first to be on the IBM bandwagon and it has really been putting on a show for the past few days."

The shares rallied 8-1/8 points Friday after bullish Merrill Lynch comments and added another two on Monday after positive Morgan Stanley comments. IBM rose another 5-1/2 to 152-1/2 Tuesday afternoon.
"The stock is too late to buy now but too early to sell. There's nothing wrong from a technical point. Even with a pullback, longer-term it looks good to us," Tower added.
